purpose: SSS 투구·갑옷 보강 및 창 형태 정리
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: premium SSS mercenary character illustration for a fantasy collectible card game, portrait 2:3, no card frame or typography.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and the design authority. Refine this exact armored knight rather than inventing a replacement character.

Preserve the original full-body ivory-gold aura: luminous flowing energy, fine sparks, star glints and dramatic gold rim light circling the helmet, shoulders, torso, hips and legs. Preserve the dark cathedral, dark restrained palette, atmospheric floor mist, polished black/gunmetal and silver armor, imposing adult knight proportions, three-quarter stance, and the existing composition and painterly fantasy illustration finish.

The requested changes are a modest but deliberate SSS-quality upgrade of the HELMET and ARMOR, and making the offensive weapon unambiguously a SPEAR:
1. Helmet: retain the fully enclosed, pointed black-and-silver helmet and its identity. Give it a more regal and memorable sculpted silhouette with a refined integrated central crest and swept crown-like side ridges; layered silver brow/cheek plates, subtle engraved channels and narrow warm-gold highlights. Add depth and expert metal craftsmanship rather than merely multiplying spikes. Do not expose a human face.
2. Armor: retain the original fitted articulated plate structure and silhouette. Enrich the breastplate, pauldrons, gauntlets and leg armor with deliberate raised silver contours, a few restrained gold inlays, finely engraved ornamental motifs and richer overlapping plate construction. Keep broad dark metal areas for contrast. Make the chest and shoulder forms feel worthy of an SSS knight while only moderately increasing ornamentation. Keep the body solid and fully readable beneath the aura.
3. Weapon: the main offensive weapon is ONE elegant two-handed-length spear with a long slender RIGID STRAIGHT shaft and a clearly readable long, pointed, symmetric thrusting spearhead. Preserve the reference weapon's black/silver metal, gold edges and flowing gold energy; make its craftsmanship match the upgraded helmet and armor. Maintain a plausible hand grip and a single continuous straight axis from spear tip through shaft to the butt. Keep the established diagonal spear placement. The broad piece on the opposite forearm remains the original ornamental shield, visually distinct from the spear, retaining its dark silver angular design. No sword, scythe, axe blade, bow or duplicate spear.
Change only what is needed for these refinements. No additional characters, wings, new cape, extra limbs, oversized crown, broad color change, busy all-over gold engraving, or redesigned background. Preserve the original elegant proportions and pose. Crisp premium metal details and excellent material separation, no plastic 3D look. No text, title, rank letters, logo, watermark or UI.
